h1: Use Hanzo AI with Anthropic SDK

p: Use the Anthropic Python or TypeScript SDK with Hanzo AI to access Claude models alongside 50+ other models through a single API key and billing account.
API Key: Get yours at platform.hanzo.ai/api-keys · Fully OpenAI-compatible · every model on the gateway available
License: MIT · View source on GitHub →
Hanzo AI is OpenAI-compatible, so existing Anthropic SDK code works with zero refactoring. We deeply appreciate the Anthropic team for building and maintaining this open-source project.

code: pip install anthropic import anthropic client = anthropic . Anthropic ( api_key= " your-hanzo-api-key " , base_url= " https://api.hanzo.ai/v1 " , ) message = client . messages . create ( model= " anthropic/claude-sonnet-4-6 " , max_tokens= 1024 , messages= [{ " role " : " user " , " content " : " Hello, Claude! " }], ) print ( message . content [ 0 ]. text )

import Anthropic from " @anthropic-ai/sdk " ; const client = new Anthropic ({ apiKey : process.env.HANZO_API_KEY , baseURL : " https://api.hanzo.ai/v1 " , }); const message = await client.messages. create ({ model : " anthropic/claude-sonnet-4-6 " , max_tokens : 1024 , messages : [{ role : " user " , content : " Hello! " }], });

with client . messages . stream ( model= " enso " , max_tokens= 1024 , messages= [{ " role " : " user " , " content " : " Tell me a story " }], ) as stream : for text in stream . text_stream : print ( text , end= "" , flush= True )

curl https://api.hanzo.ai/v1/messages \ -H " x-api-key: $ HANZO_API_KEY " \ -H " anthropic-version: 2023-06-01 " \ -H " content-type: application/json " \ -d ' {"model":"anthropic/claude-sonnet-4-6","max_tokens":100,"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"Hi"}]} '

p: Create a free account and get your API key. The Free plan includes free model requests and Kai decisions, no card.
